headline: Battery Revolution: In 2 Years, Bulgaria Surprised Everyone in Europe; State Inaction Turned Out to Be an Advantage
summary: Bulgaria has become one of the fastest-growing markets for industrial batteries in Europe within two years. Batteries are no longer used only to store cheap energy.
why: Industrial battery storage supports grid flexibility and renewable integration, creating investment opportunities in energy storage and manufacturing.
